entries.name: Ilse Marrow
entries.title: Lampwarden of Gull Harbour
entries.background: A former ship's bosun who now keeps Gull Harbour's lamp lit and its raiders out. Mara Voss's counterpart in this world: she plays exactly like her.

entries.name: Pell Driftwood
entries.title: Beachcomber Scout
entries.background: Reads tides the way Tev reads smoke.

entries.name: Brannoch Saltfist
entries.title: Reef Brawler
entries.background: Hauls his catch with one hand and punches with the other.

entries.name: Captain Dredge
entries.title: Reef Raider Captain
entries.background: A berserker with a ship. Tougher than the Horde's Bolg on purpose: the Forge shows exactly how.

entries.name: Salt-Eyed Sniper
entries.title: Mast Archer
entries.background: Perches in rigging and shoots anyone who looks up.

entries.name: Tide-Whisper
entries.title: Reef Shaman
entries.background: Listens to the surf for omens.

entries.name: Gull-Hand
entries.title: Raider
entries.background: Quick, light and never where you aimed.
